description: This source file implements backend APIs for DNS management in the COSA Data Model, including creation, initialization, removal, registration, and internal data management of DNS server and relay configurations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaDNSCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new COSA DNS object, setting up essential function pointers and environment.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDNSInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs initialization of the DNS data model, including loading existing DNS server and relay info from registry.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDNSRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and removes the DNS data model, including freeing allocated resources and deleting registry entries.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDNSRegGetInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves and populates current DNS server and relay configuration info from persistent storage.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDNSRegAddInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Adds new DNS server or relay info entries into the persistent registry storage.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDNSRegDelInfo(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
methods.description: Deletes specific DNS server or relay info entries from the persistent registry storage.

ctags.name: CosaDNSRegAddInfo
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pNextInsNumName,ULONG ulNextInsNum,char * pPreffix,ULONG ulUpperInsNum,char * pAlias,ANSC_HANDLE hCosaContext)
